capabilities.ui: web app (shared Web Host) and reviewer renderer

limitations: Synthetic data only: no live weather, air-quality or alert feeds.
PM2.5 and PM10 AQI use hourly concentrations, not EPA NowCast; O3 uses the 8-hour rolling mean.
No global scheduler: time moves through events and Infra's env.advance_time, which runs no App code.
The outbound Mail adapter is invoked explicitly by the example and tests; automatic invocation belongs to the planned runner.
Web pages are served by the shared loopback Web Host; no production remote deployment.
